rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CALL AddCol('hdc','s_kpi_dental40','total','int(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_kpi_dental40(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	target int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	total int(9) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_kpi_dental40 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmpz_dental;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmpz_dental (PRIMARY KEY(cid) ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 IGNORE AS
SELECT p.*
,IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,d.DATE_SERV) BETWEEN 60 AND 199
				AND PTEETH BETWEEN 0 AND 32
				AND IFNULL(PERMANENT_PERMANENT,0) + IFNULL(PERMANENT_PROSTHESIS,0) + IFNULL(PROSTHESIS_PROSTHESIS,0)
				BETWEEN 0 AND 10				
				AND (IFNULL(d.pteeth,0) +IFNULL(d.PEXTRACT,0)) > 0 
				AND d.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d  
				AND p1.PROVIDERTYPE in(2,6)  
				,1,0) AS result1
,IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,d.DATE_SERV) BETWEEN 60 AND 199
				AND IFNULL(PERMANENT_PERMANENT,0) + IFNULL(PERMANENT_PROSTHESIS,0) + IFNULL(PROSTHESIS_PROSTHESIS,0)
				BETWEEN 0 AND 10				
				AND d.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d  
				AND p1.PROVIDERTYPE in(2,6)   
				AND (IFNULL(d.pteeth,0) +IFNULL(d.PEXTRACT,0)) > 0 
				AND (IFNULL(d.pteeth,0) - IFNULL(d.need_pextract,0)) >= 20 
			,1,0) AS result2
FROM
		t_person_cid	p LEFT JOIN 	tmp_dental_last d  ON  p.CID=d.CID 
		LEFT JOIN provider p1 ON d.HOSPCODE=p1.HOSPCODE  AND d.PROVIDER=p1.PROVIDER
		LEFT JOIN chospital h ON p.HOSPCODE=h.hoscode 	AND h.provcode in(@prov_c) 
WHERE  TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.birth,concat(@b_year,'0101'))  BETWEEN 60 AND 199 AND  check_typearea IN(1,3) AND DISCHARGE IN(9)
GROUP BY p.cid;

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_kpi_dental40
(
SELECT
@id,d.hospcode,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
	,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(result1 IN(1), d.cid,null)) target
	,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(result2 IN(1), d.cid,null)) result
	,COUNT(DISTINCT d.cid) total
FROM
		tmpz_dental d	INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.HOSPCODE=h.hoscode 	AND h.provcode in(@prov_c) 
GROUP BY d.hospcode
);

rows.indiv_sql:
SET @prov_c := (SELECT provincecode FROM sys_config LIMIT 1);
SET @b_year := (SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d := concat(@b_year - 1, '1001');
SET @end_d := concat(@b_year, '0930');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx; 
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 IGNORE  AS
SELECT
p.hospcode,p.pid,p.CID,p.NAME,p.LNAME,p.BIRTH,p.SEX,p.NATION,p.check_typearea
,p.addr,p.check_vhid,p.DISCHARGE
,TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.birth,concat(@b_year,'0101'))  as age_y
,SEQ,DATE_SERV,DENTTYPE,SERVPLACE,PTEETH,PCARIES,PFILLING,PEXTRACT,DTEETH,DCARIES,DFILLING,DEXTRACT,NEED_FLUORIDE,NEED_SCALING,NEED_SEALANT,NEED_PFILLING,NEED_DFILLING,NEED_PEXTRACT,NEED_DEXTRACT,NPROSTHESIS,PERMANENT_PERMANENT,PERMANENT_PROSTHESIS,PROSTHESIS_PROSTHESIS,GUM,SCHOOLTYPE,CLASS
,d.PROVIDER,p1.PROVIDERTYPE,IF(p1.PROVIDERTYPE in(2,6) 
				AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,d.DATE_SERV) BETWEEN 60 AND 199   
				AND IFNULL(PERMANENT_PERMANENT,0) + IFNULL(PERMANENT_PROSTHESIS,0) 
								+ IFNULL		(PROSTHESIS_PROSTHESIS,0)		BETWEEN 0 AND 10				
				AND (IFNULL(d.pteeth,0) +IFNULL(d.PEXTRACT,0)) > 0 
				AND d.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
				AND (IFNULL(d.pteeth,0) - IFNULL(d.need_pextract,0)) >= 20  ,'ผ่านเกณฑ์','ไม่ตามเกณฑ์') as RESULT 
FROM
		t_person_cid p 	LEFT JOIN tmp_dental_last d  ON  p.CID=d.CID 
		LEFT JOIN provider p1 ON d.HOSPCODE=p1.HOSPCODE  AND d.PROVIDER=p1.PROVIDER 
WHERE  TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.birth,concat(@b_year,'0101'))  BETWEEN 60 AND 199  AND  check_typearea IN(1,3) AND DISCHARGE IN(9)  GROUP BY p.CID
;
SELECT
h.hoscode,h.hosname,d.pid,d.CID,d.NAME,d.LNAME,d.BIRTH,d.SEX,d.NATION,d.check_typearea,d.addr,d.check_vhid,d.DISCHARGE
,d.age_y
,d.SEQ,d.DATE_SERV,d.DENTTYPE,d.SERVPLACE,d.PTEETH,d.PCARIES,d.PFILLING,d.PEXTRACT,d.DTEETH,d.DCARIES,d.DFILLING,d.DEXTRACT,d.NEED_FLUORIDE,d.NEED_SCALING,d.NEED_SEALANT,d.NEED_PFILLING,d.NEED_DFILLING,d.NEED_PEXTRACT,d.NEED_DEXTRACT,d.NPROSTHESIS,d.PERMANENT_PERMANENT,d.PERMANENT_PROSTHESIS,d.PROSTHESIS_PROSTHESIS,d.GUM,d.SCHOOLTYPE,d.CLASS,d.PROVIDER,d.PROVIDERTYPE,d.RESULT
FROM
tx d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM(target) as target ,SUM(result) as result ,SUM(total) as total FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
